verdict.rationale: Motion documents booking capabilities, including embeddable booking calendars and branded meeting links, but nothing in the pack shows a free tier or says booking links are available without a paid plan. The pricing evidence covers only paid offerings such as Business AI and per-seat credits, so the free-tier part of this story is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a founder, the free tier covers real individual scheduling — a usable booking link without a paid plan
